Yukon is a patience (solitaire) card game using a single 52-card deck, in the Klondike family. Unlike Klondike, it has no stock; all 52 cards are dealt at the start into seven tableau columns, with the top five cards of each column face-up and the rest face-down. It is classified as a half-open packer. The game is documented in references such as Roya's Card Night (2021) and in solitaire literature; its exact origin and the reason for the Yukon name are not fully documented in the sources.
52 cards. All dealt to 7 columns. No stock.
7 columns: col1=1 face-up. Cols 2-7: face-down cards + 5 face-up each.
